avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer reduces lopinavir plasma concentrations by up to 75%, compromising antiviral efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently. Consider alternative mood support if needed.

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce lopinavir bioavailability and therapeutic levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose garlic supplements; culinary amounts are acceptable.

avoid_supplements.name: Rifabutin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer significantly decreases lopinavir concentrations
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; alternative TB medications should be considered.

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 inhibition may increase lopinavir levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for signs of lopinavir toxicity (GI upset, elevated liver enzymes); limit consumption.

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Possible mild CYP3A4 modulation; uncertain clinical significance
caution_supplements.action: Use with monitoring; assess for changes in viral load or tolerability.

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases lopinavir plasma concentrations, raising toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit products; substitute with other citrus fruits if desired.

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Increased absorption of lopinavir (formulation-dependent); may enhance bioavailability variably
caution_foods.action: Consistent meal pattern recommended; take with food as directed; maintain stable dietary fat intake.

caution_foods.name: Calcium-fortified foods and supplements
caution_foods.mechanism: May reduce lopinavir absorption if taken simultaneously
caution_foods.action: Separate lopinavir and calcium-rich foods/supplements by at least 2 hours.

monitoring_notes: Monitor viral load, CD4 count, and liver function regularly as CYP3A4 interactions may compromise antiviral efficacy or increase toxicity. Counsel patients on strict adherence and to report all supplements and dietary changes to avoid treatment failure.
